title: How to use Kubernetes Monitoring dashboards

blocks.title: How to use Kubernetes Monitoring dashboards

blocks.content:
This demonstration video highlights the Grafana Kubernetes Monitoring pre-built dashboard and its capabilities for managing clusters, nodes, namespaces, and workloads.

It starts with a default view that displays all relevant information, then shows filtering options for focused insights on node and pod counts, CPU, memory utilization, and current alerts.

The dashboard supports fast navigation and detailed troubleshooting views. Each section lets you sort and filter data to identify high utilization patterns and errors efficiently.
